integrity: One complete proof and one exact-rational reproducibility script; independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns connected simple undirected graphs with raw symmetric binary adjacency and globally normalized statistics, all nonconstant real attribute fields, and deterministic index ranking. It does not extend to row-stochastic weights, binary-only thresholds, inference, or weighted/directed networks. The possibility of stronger previous algebraic coverage is acknowledged.
title: Regular graphs and stars are exactly the networks with universal Moran–Geary ranking agreement
